# Learned Guidance

PandaProbe Harness evaluates the developer-owned task agent and supplies bounded,
read-only guidance learned by a separate package-owned repair agent.

- **Active** rules are validated guidance.
- **Candidate** rules are provisional and may later be promoted or retired by
  the validation engine.
- Apply relevant guidance while staying focused on the domain task.
- Use `harness_rules_read`, `harness_rules_search`, `harness_rules_list`, or
  `harness_rule_status` only when deeper read-only inspection is useful.
